g.title: Case and channel [observed]
g.desc: Corrected event CSV: CaseId, Activity, Actor; order channel comes from the source file. No customer identity or timestamp is available. Sales IDs are not case IDs. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.title: Pizza type / size [source fields]
g.desc: The Sales worksheets record Pizza Type and Pizza Size. Using those fields as a preparation specification is an authored information-flow assumption; there is no row-level sales-to-case join. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.title: Price catalogue [source]
g.desc: PizzasInfo: 18 type/size entries, recorded cost and revenue. Monetary unit is unspecified. The association with settlement describes a proposed information interface, not a recorded data exchange. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.title: Recorded sales [source]
g.desc: Sales fields: Id, StructureId, Pizza Type, Pizza Size, Revenue, Cost, Satisfaction, Weekday, Customer Location, Customer Type. This is a sales record, not proof of a distinct customer or an event-log transaction. Cached Excel values are used; formulas are never executed. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.title: Customer location [source field]
g.desc: Customer Location is a geographic category in Sales, not a street address or a case-linked delivery instruction. Its proposed use in planning is an explicit modeling assumption. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.data-name: * Roles inferred from tasks. People are observed. 5 business events have no actor.
g.title: * Roles inferred from tasks. People are observed. 5 business events have no actor.
g.desc: William handles intake and Internet approval/contact/modification/cancellation. Patrick and Robert prepare, bake and pack. Jack, Paul, Richard and Harry plan/deliver and settle delivered orders. Counter and pickup settlement is assigned to William. Unknown Counter Prepare actors are retained, not filled from adjacent events. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.

g.data-name: Loops and order flexibility are observed; their business cause and timing are unknown.
g.title: Loops and order flexibility are observed; their business cause and timing are unknown.
g.desc: Prepare -> Bake -> Pack repeats one to three times in the logs. The model generalizes this as a loop; no defect/rework cause or one-cycle/one-sale equivalence is asserted. Cash and Give order occur in both orders. Logical parallel routing expresses that flexibility, not simultaneous human work. Branch labels are explanatory, not an executable decision engine. In the global view this is a shared information concept for every applicable branch; a representative association is drawn to keep the diagram readable.
